source: The 2022 studio working copy of this generator, hashlips_art_engine-1.1.2_patch_v1: the copy this recovery imported src/config.js, src/main.js and the lockfiles from. Read 2026-11-14.
scope: Every file the engine reads in each family folder present in that copy: 11 of the 16 families src/config.js names. Folders and files whose names start with a dot are skipped, as the engine skips them. antena B, boca B, chápeu B, camisa queimando and superaquecimento are not in that copy; see unresolved.json.
weights: Each weight is parsed as src/main.js parses it in getRarityWeight: the number after the last # in the file name without its four-character extension, or 1 when that is not a number.
names: Family and file names are recorded in Unicode NFC. A family or file marked "source_form": "NFD" is stored decomposed in the source, and its exact source name is the NFD form of the recorded name. Compare names after NFC normalization.
checksums: sha256 is the SHA-256 of the file's bytes. No image is published; only names, weights and checksums.
